links.outcome: Readability (FRE, FKGL) of chatbot answers to patient questions about endophthalmitis
links.effect: A-Eye Consult and ChatGPT-4.0 responses were more complex than those of the other LLMs, while being more reliable and accurate. No FRE or FKGL values are reported in the abstract.
links.quote: A-Eye Consult and ChatGPT-4.0 responses, while more complex than those of other LLMs, provided more reliable and accurate information.

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy, reliability (DISCERN), and readability of four LLMs answering patient FAQs regarding endophthalmitis without testing a specific organizational deployment safeguard.
